# Filename

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Filename`](gmeow-Filename.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Filename>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

An appellation borne by a digital file — a stem and an extension. The extension CLAIMS a content type ([`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-claimedMediaType.md)) which may disagree with the type detected from the bytes ([`gmeow:detectedMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-detectedMediaType.md)); the disagreement is recorded as coexisting claims with confidence, never reasoned into a contradiction.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Filename`](gmeow-Filename.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
